summary: Joe Bevan has made history at Sandbach United, scoring a brace in their last match to become the club's all-time leading goalscorer with 56 goals, surpassing James Kirby's previous record of 54. The Ramblers are looking to build on this momentum with back-to-back wins as they travel to Foley FC. With the season stretching ahead, Bevan will be aiming to add significantly to his impressive tally.
